decision: retain SQLite; measure before optionally adding Chroma as independent vector backend

current.structured: SQLite symbols, symbol_references, parse_status; package relation graph independent research prototype
current.vectors: SQLite normalized float32, Python linear exact cosine top-k
current.database: fixed single-repository index; user index currently has zero vectors
current.query_default: lexical/symbol routing; no default RRF or production abstention threshold
current.tests: in-memory SQLite and temporary isolated databases; one legacy test incorrectly asserts mutable formal index hash

chroma.single_node: SQLite-backed metadata plus HNSW vector index, version dependent
chroma.client: persistent and ephemeral Python clients, server mode optional
chroma.windows: published Windows x86-64 wheel; not installed or tested here
chroma.index: HNSW approximate nearest neighbours; distance semantics differ from cosine similarity
